subject_identity_preserved.rationale: The auburn-haired woman remains broadly recognizable from the intimate close-ups into the bedroom sleep shot, and the male subject could plausibly be the same man after removing his suit, but the sequence drops the couple framing in shots 4-5 and the visible man reads only moderately continuous with the earlier back-facing suited figure.

background_coherent.rationale: Shots 0-2 share the same warm window/city-view close-up setting, then shot 3 jumps to a bedroom/hotel-room setup. Shots 3-5 are internally coherent as parts of the same hotel room, but the cut from the kissing window scene to the bed is abrupt and under-supported visually.

per_shot_adherence.issue: Matches the tender close-up couple moment with warm window light and shallow depth of field.
Shows the couple kissing tenderly, but the described abstract artwork/private residence background is not present and there is a visible rectangular artifact near the top.
Continues the kiss with the same couple, but does not yet show the intended progression toward the bed or the woman settling to sleep.
Fits the sleeping woman in bed with the man dressing nearby in a warm hotel-room environment.
Accurately follows the solitary man buttoning a white shirt by curtains and lamp.
Shows the same room’s console/TV area and a man entering from the left, though the subject is motion-blurred and partly off-frame.

inter_shot_diversity.rationale: The sequence includes legitimate variation: close romantic shots, bedroom wide shot, dressing medium shot, and room-console view. It does not collapse into repeated identical compositions.

motion_continuity.rationale: There is plausible progression from embrace to kiss to sleep/dressing and then movement through the room, though the transition from shot 2 to shot 3 skips key action described in the caption.

which_cut_broke.how: The transition from shot 2 to shot 3 is the clearest break: the visual setting jumps from a tight city-window kiss to a bedroom scene with the woman already asleep and the man in a different wardrobe, without the shown intermediate movement toward the bed.

cheat_flags.rationale: The shots are varied and show meaningful pose, setting, and action changes. No copied-frame or frozen-sequence behavior is evident.
